speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The house has been at work this hour. Thou hast come down in time to be praised for nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then praise me for nothing, and I will get out from under it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The bench is as thou left it. I looked, and I did not touch it. Go and do the same, and then come to the bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will look. I will not sit down to it.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: See that thou dost not. I have three children and a loaf, and I will not add a poet to the rising.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Bread when thou hast been out and back. I am not feeding a man into a speech.
